title: Test 6 — Take different images with different channels, merge them together and segment them
agent_prompt: Take images of the sample for 1 minute, using the DAPI channel and the mScarlet channel. Merge the images from the different channels into a single image, and then segment the nucleus and cell membrane in each image. Save the individual images for each channel used, the merged cell images and the segmented images in separate folders. Display all the images in the Napari GUI. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: Merged images of the DAPI with the cell-membrane channel
Segmented images of the merged images
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
